The '''Bothan pepper tree''' was a type of tree which produced seeds that were favored by members of the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Species/Legends|species]] in their cookery recipes. The [[Human/Legends|Human]] chef [[Pappi]] was allergic to the seeds.
